anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or a bottleneck.
No active trades or recent learning cycles in the AI module, suggesting a potential issue with the trading strategies or AI functionality.
Zero total profit/loss (PL) and return on investment (ROI) despite having closed trades, indicating that all trades may have resulted in a break-even or loss.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially adjust trading strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and aligned with current market conditions.
Enhance AI module to generate opportunities and make adjustments to improve trading outcomes.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough investigation of CPU usage to identify and mitigate any bottlenecks or inefficient processes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Audit and test the active trading strategies to ensure they are executing as expected and adjust them based on current market analysis.
recommendations.rationale: Inactive trades and zero PL/ROI suggest that strategies may not be functioning optimally, risking missed opportunities.
